disambiguation: Not just a note-sharing tool; it provides full vault synchronization and collaborative editing features.
extras: Requires self-hosted server setup. No E2E encryption or billing. Maximum individual synchronized file size is 20 MiB.
problem: Lack of native real-time collaboration and robust, decentralized vault synchronization capabilities in Obsidian.
summary: A self-hosted plugin enabling real-time collaborative Markdown editing and vault synchronization across devices using CRDT technology.
